about_the_game:
A return to the roots!

Traveler's Journey is a Voxel, Isometric, Tactical Turn based RPG. Travel through the islands as a lone leather worker as you unveil the secrets long since kept away from the villagers.

Step into a world of voxels, you the player will traverse the lands completing quests, collecting resources, learning new skills to improve your chances of survival. This all new experience is nothing like you've been able to see before, not only dose this strategy game test your endurance. It will also your tactical prowess as you are tasked to think three turns ahead. Equipment isn't just found or bought, they tell their own story as you forge not only your path but sword & shield.

This will allow another layer even more custom look to your character. Here your choices matter, will you spare certain character's, or take everything you can out?
